method: Task-based discovery, named-method expansion, backward/related citation checks and primary-source inspection. No experimental reproduction.
limitations: Not a preregistered systematic review or guaranteed exhaustive census.
Evidence depth varies; abstract-only records are not full protocol audits.
Workflow and scope labels are editorial analysis, not necessarily author terminology.
Remote availability and publication revisions can change after the checked date.

coverage_notes.root: Primary source checks completed 2026-10-31. No experiments reproduced; dates denote first arXiv publication. Scene reconstruction is contextual.
coverage_notes.code: SVG and TikZ generation/reconstruction/editing; diagrams; charts; scientific figures; layered graphic/poster design; webpage visual-code work retained only as adjacent context.
generation: Broad generation coverage rather than a claim of exhaustive literature retrieval. Bibliographic years use first arXiv submission year; conference years may differ.
All records were checked through primary arXiv abstracts or full text; exact quantitative claims were deliberately omitted unless needed to identify evaluation scope.
AgentT2I was not positively identified and was not invented.
DraCo, PSP-DiT, MetaPoint and simplified vector graphics are component/context contrasts, not coding agents.
Pure foundation image models, adversarial/safety attack generation, domain-specific synthetic-data systems, and image-understanding-only agents are outside this branch.
AgentDrawBench/MaLiang are owned by parent; diagram/SVG/chart/COLE design lineage by code-image researcher; editing/restoration and generic evaluation by editing researcher.
edit-eval: Years are first public preprint years, not inferred conference years.
Workflow labels describe inspected mechanisms; W4 is not assigned merely because multiple user turns occur.
Broad inclusion of orchestration is deliberate but each record caveat distinguishes code generation from prompt/control-only agents.
Pure visual QA agents (ViperGPT/IMAgent multi-image QA), unrelated AgentEdit tools, and the 2026 video-world EditWorld are excluded.
Sources were checked at abstract level unless explicitly labeled full paper/project; no experiments were reproduced.
Selected benchmark crosswalks below record only explicit primary-source correspondences, not recommended evaluations.
